clips.title: The story
paras: At Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum, a summons calls promising Alliance mages to the tower's summit. Andromath works among the kingdom's foremost archmages beyond ruined Dalaran.

Jennea Cannon, the apprentice coordinator in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, sends promising casters up to the Wizard's Sanctum summit. High Sorcerer Andromath, among the southern kingdoms' most senior active practitioners of the arcane, has asked to meet magi ready for greater responsibilities.

Dalaran's magocracy was ruined in the Third War, and its surviving wizards are occupied with rebuilding. Without easy access to the Violet Citadel's libraries, the Alliance depends on senior archmages in Stormwind to study ancient threats and guide research into shadowy, forbidden arts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, friend. He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of Stormwind.
It would be wise to speak with him, for Andromath is one of the most powerful mages not locked away in Dalaran. Council with him is high council indeed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, friend. I am pleased to see you, and hope you have time to listen to an old man's words...
